result.summary: The page generally looks clean, but the system gesture/home-indicator bar overlaps the middle icons of the bottom navigation, partially covering the search icon.

issues.description: The dark home-indicator bar overlaps the center of the bottom navigation, partially covering the search icon and creating visual clutter.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/spacing so the bottom navigation icons sit clear of the system home indicator area, or inset the nav bar content.
